reason: Every unserved schema arm and unconsumed route declares its current owner and missing consumer.

bindings.note: All production workflow workbook declarations are intentionally empty. Generic captured-reference writes, native Logs receipts and row resolution are exercised by the synthetic declared consumer in tests/backend/runs/workbooks.integration.test.ts; Onboarding phase 2 owns the first real declaration and mapping.

Ref frontend-backend-integration §3.3's Review panel kind. `availableSections` cannot return it for any lifecycle: no registered descriptor declares a review panel, and the review record store is deferred. Closes with the first workflow that declares one.
The operation-member People page, same deferral as `review`; `sectionsCompatible` already refuses it beside `review` on one panel. Closes with the first multi-person operation workflow.

Ref dashboard-surfaces §1.1's Evidence rail. `buildRunDetail` serves `context.evidenceFacts: 0` with the comment that the evidence service is a later slice, so no composition can populate this arm; the receipt section serves the trust content that exists today.
The route is served, but no mounted dashboard consumer invokes it.
Queued Spreadsheets workbook wiring will load the selected workbook type and SharePoint link for its library/editor state; backend-first library work leaves these served metadata unconsumed.
Queued Spreadsheets Versions wiring will supply spreadsheet-versions.tsx with served manual named versions and migration provenance instead of the current history presentation producer.

Queued Spreadsheets change-log wiring will read the selected master operation journal to show run and Sync source, keyed cells, old/new values and resolution state; this backend-first API has no mounted journal consumer yet.
Queued Spreadsheets workbook command wiring will dispatch operator manual named-version and metadata changes through the typed dashboard client; the backend-first command has no mounted consumer yet.
Queued Spreadsheets manual Sync wiring will dispatch the selected workbook SharePoint refresh through the typed dashboard client; the backend-first API has no mounted Sync consumer yet.
